inputs.film_sha: source SHA of the film revision
inputs.host_mesh_sha256: content hash of the rest mesh/rig as rendered (PASSES.json)
inputs.rig_action_sha256: hash of the evaluated per-frame performance as rendered
inputs.calibration_landmarks: ≥2 reviewed floor landmarks of the approved WORLD_PLANE {world, plate_px}
inputs.foreground_occluder_ids: approved assets nearer than the host band
inputs.lighting_profile: approved key-light direction/colour (human-reviewed; not yet machine-checked)
inputs.sound_cue_ids: audio cues the host performance is timed to

outputs.shadow_rgba: shadow_NNNNNN.png, shadow-catcher ground, host invisible to camera
outputs.PASSES.json: camera_used.matrix_world, per-frame film/blender frame map, sha256 per pass, contact world+px, fps, alpha_mode, host_mesh_sha256, rig_action_sha256, blender_version
outputs.depth_or_matte: NOT YET PRODUCED (add an object-ID matte only when an approved shot needs inter-penetrating occlusion)

rejections: diagnostic stand-in in PRODUCTION, unapproved host, missing .blend sha/receipt
Blender camera ≠ contract (1e-4), contact projection disagreement > 0.5 px, 2D camera moving while a host pass is visible
painted floor landmarks off by > 2 px, fewer than 2 landmarks
passes not rendered at the film clock
mesh/rig or performance changed without a re-render
a pass with its own background (pasted rectangle)
a 'foreground' occluder not in front of the host band
composited frame shows the host through the counter, or no shadow
tests: TBO-G14 host pass (real Blender 5.1 Cycles + Chrome; DIAGNOSTIC capsule)

status.technical_adapter: VERIFIED_CODE on a DIAGNOSTIC capsule (not a host design)
status.production_host: HOST_3D_ASSET_PENDING: approved original host concept → Blender master (mesh, armature, face controls, performance) by a human modeller/rigger
